title: Equiangular lines in dimensions 18 to 20
text:
equiangular lines in dimensions 18 to 20

no one knew how many lines can pass through one point in 18, 19 or 20 dimensions with every pair meeting at the same angle. valjakas djaljapayan, zhen-qi liao and wei-hsuan yu, working with gpt-6, prove it is 57, 72 and 90.
